verdict.rationale: Calendly's own scheduling page documents meeting buffers and daily limits as availability controls, which covers roughly half the story. A community request to cap total booked hours per day is about a different metric than a daily meeting limit, so it does not contradict the claim. Missing for 10: before/after buffer specifics, minimum-notice setting, date-range booking windows, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a knowledge worker, I can protect my calendar with buffers before and after meetings, minimum notice, daily booking caps, and date-range windows

citations.quote: Only get booked when you want to be. Connect multiple calendars and fine-tune your availability with meeting buffers, custom schedules, and daily limits.
